description: This file defines the configuration options class 'AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions' used for setting up the Azure Blob Storage-based state machine storage provider within Orleans. It contains properties and methods for managing the blob service client, container name, blob naming delegate, and initialization stage, along with multiple configuration methods for different Azure authentication approaches.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions
classes.description: A class providing configuration options for the Azure Append Blob state machine storage provider, including blob client setup, container name, blob naming, and lifecycle initialization stage.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set up the BlobServiceClient using various authentication mechanisms such as connection string, URI, callback, and credentials.
